description: Test set for Signpath_RAG.py and signpath_answer.py (--eval-retrieval and the Evaluation tab). Each question lists the documentation sections that answer it, as section paths exactly as stored in the index ('Page > Heading > Sub-heading'). A retrieved chunk counts as relevant when its section equals one of these paths or is a sub-section of it. 'category' groups questions by topic; 'origin' is 'hand-written' or 'generated' (written by gpt-4.1 from the labelled section). Questions in the 'out_of_scope' category have no relevant sections: the docs do not cover them, so the search should find nothing relevant and the assistant should refuse.
